title: Send a message from item details and verify history loads when reopening the thread
description: Verifies a student can send a message about an item, return to the messages inbox, reopen the conversation, and see the previously sent message in the thread.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation entry to create a marketplace listing
Fill in the title field with Messaging History Item TC
Fill in the price field with 10
Select a valid category
Fill in the item details field with Used to validate chat thread persistence
Submit the listing
Click the market tab
Open the listing titled Messaging History Item TC from the list
Click the message action from the item details view
Fill a message into the chat input with Thread persistence check message
Send the message
Click the navigation control to return to the messages inbox
Open the most recent conversation from the inbox
Verify the previously sent message is displayed in the conversation thread
